next.reason: §2023:14.9.11.4 GR1: 'causes the content of each operand to be transferred to the device in the order listed', conversion 'defined by the implementor' (DOC-A.1-56), as 1985; §2023:14.9.11.4 GR6 restates the order. The added 'zero-length data item or a zero-length literal, no data is transferred' changes nothing a 1985 program can write: a 1985 zero-length operand also transfers nothing, and the empty literal is a literal-rule change, not this rule's.
